caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure with brown skin, long black hair, and a feathered headdress featuring feathers colored in shades of purple, red, orange, and white. The figure is dressed in a red skirt with a yellow-gold border and a dark brown fur or cloth sash draped over one shoulder and crossing the chest. He wears a yellow necklace and brown moccasin-like shoes. The man is posed with his left foot on a rock, left arm bent holding a bundle of brown cylindrical objects and a grey rectangular object, and his right arm raised with the hand at his brow as if shielding his eyes to look into the distance. The statue stands on a two-tiered rectangular base colored grey and black, simulating stone. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Cigar Store Indian
